summary: flatnotes is a web-based note-taking application designed for personal knowledge management. It stores all your notes as plain Markdown files directly within a designated folder, meaning there is no separate database engine required.
goodFor: It is well-suited for users who prefer keeping their notes in standard file formats that remain accessible outside the application itself.
watchOut: Because it relies entirely on a flat file structure without an underlying database, performance may degrade as the number of individual markdown files scales significantly.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure a Docker volume to persist your markdown directory outside the container, along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
